name: Goi ca chich
summary: A small freshwater fish. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định says it is fried whole and eaten in a phở sheet with herbs and cucumber, or served raw after the bones are taken out.
origin: Quy Nhon. The provincial portal says the fish lives in rivers, lakes, ponds, and streams, and addresses the plate to the city.
howToEat: The fried fish goes into a phở sheet with herbs and cucumber. The raw plate is boned fish. Cổng thông tin điện tử tỉnh Bình Định does not choose one.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: The address field is Quy Nhon. A street was not printed.
seoTitle: Goi ca chich — Quy Nhon freshwater fish
seoDescription: Cá chích is fried whole in a phở sheet or served as a raw salad. The provincial portal addresses it to Quy Nhon and names no street. Check on arrival.
